etymology.historical_story: Ryuseikai occurs as a romanized institutional name: an Okinawan martial arts organisation uses it alongside 琉成會. That attestation establishes one real use, not the identity of this packet's token. Without its original script or source context, assigning a translation, founding story, or Japanese pronunciation would turn a possible match into an unsupported claim. [Organisation website](https://ryuseikai2022.jp/).
